summary: Package exports an OpenSSL-encrypted opaque blob with no in-package decrypt or execute path
details: thedata@1.0.6 ships a single artifact: apps/docs/app/des.db, a base64-encoded OpenSSL-encrypted blob (Salted__ prefix). The package's main entry reads that file with readFileSync and re-exports its contents as `desKey`. The package performs no network I/O, no shell execution, no eval, no dynamic require, and declares no install/lifecycle hooks; there is no code path within the package that decrypts, loads, or executes the blob. Installing or importing this package on its own does not read installer secrets, contact any network destination, or execute the opaque payload. The shape (thin wrapper whose only export is an encrypted opaque blob) is atypical for a self-contained library and is consistent with a ciphertext carrier intended to be paired with a separate decryptor, but no such paired code is present in this package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
